---
title: Cross-reference after a nested removed header
format:
  typst: default
from: markdown-auto_identifiers
filters:
  - veil
extensions:
  veil:
    groups:
      - name: x
        shown: false
      - name: "y"
        shown: false
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        warnings: exhaustive
    typst:
      noErrors: true
      printsMessage:
        - level: WARN
          regex: "`@sec-deep` points to content that the group `x` removed"
          count: 1
        - level: WARN
          regex: "Unable to resolve crossref @sec-deep"
          count: 1
---

# Overview

See @sec-deep for details.

# Part {.veil group="x"}

## B {.veil group="y"}

Text.

## D

### Deep dive {#sec-deep}

Deep text.

# Other

## B {.veil group="y"}

Text.
